usage: Production albedo and registered approximate companion height data; runtime normals and ORM are derived technical data, not measured scans.

albedo_prompts.olive: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR terrain BASE COLOR texture for a realistic fixed-camera military strategy game. Generate a seamless square 2048x2048 orthographic straight-down scan-like tile covering 8 metres of dry temperate grassland. Natural tightly interwoven low olive grass, thin tangled tan straw blades, sparse flattened dead grass, and small connected exposed brown-earth gaps. A few irregular small grey/tan stones partially embedded, most areas living/dry grass, no shrubs or large objects. Rich recognisable grass strands and earthy microstructure at several scales; irregular non-directional distribution, no conspicuous swirls, raked waves, repeated round clumps or white confetti flecks. Restrained medium-dark olive/khaki and earthy warm brown palette with selective pale straw, no lime greens. Flat neutral diffuse capture without directional sunlight, cast shadows, specular highlights, vignette, perspective or depth of field. Colour-only material: no trees, roads, vehicles, text, borders, grid or watermark. Fill edge to edge; all four boundaries tile seamlessly. Crisp realistic natural surface, not painterly or cartoon.
albedo_prompts.stony: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR terrain BASE COLOR texture for a realistic fixed-camera military strategy game. Generate a seamless square 2048x2048 orthographic straight-down scan-like tile covering 6 metres of stony dry temperate grassland. Irregular angular weathered grey/taupe limestone pebbles and gravel embedded in warm brown compacted soil, interwoven low muted olive grass and fine dry straw. Realistic size hierarchy: fine grain, small grit, centimetre stones, occasional 10-20 cm stones, never large boulders. Earth and grass remain connected between irregular stones, without isolated decorative circles or uniform pale dots. Natural selective pale rock faces, no pure white stones, no lime-green plants. Medium-dark olive and warm brown with neutral grey mineral variety. Flat neutral diffuse capture without directional sunlight, cast shadows, specular highlights, vignette, perspective or depth of field. Colour-only map; no shrubs, trees, roads, vehicles, text, borders, grid or watermark. Seamless all four edges, sharp photographic microstructure, no swirling terrain patterns or cartoon shapes.
albedo_prompts.shoulder: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR BASE COLOR texture for an eroded gravel road shoulder in a realistic military strategy game. Generate a seamless square 2048x2048 orthographic straight-down scan-like tile covering 5 metres. Dry compacted warm beige-grey mineral earth with angular mixed-size grit, embedded weathered small limestone pebbles, a few scattered coarse stones, shallow irregular compacted/worn earth patches and sparse dry grass roots. Fine aggregate must read clearly, a real broken road verge rather than smooth sand or a uniform cream carpet. Restrained dusty tan, muted brown and grey; no pure white grit and no bright green vegetation. Flat neutral diffuse capture without directional sunlight, cast shadows, specular highlights, vignette, perspective or depth of field. No whole road, curbs, large rocks, plants, objects, text, borders or watermark. Tile seamlessly on all four edges. Real material colour scan with crisp subtle grain, no directional swirls or sand dunes.

height_prompts.olive: Edit target: attached olive terrain albedo tile. Create its precisely registered, same-size GRAYSCALE HEIGHT MAP for PBR material data. Preserve the location, size, outline, UV layout and edge continuity of every existing stone, blade and bare-earth patch; do not invent, remove, move or rearrange features. Replace colour and lighting entirely with physical relative surface height only: soil is middle-dark grey, embedded stone faces are light grey proportional to their height, crevices dark, thin dry grass and living blades subtle small raised ridges. No highlights, cast shadows, light-direction gradient, metallic shading, AO, text, borders or labels. A shallow natural relief signal with gentle transitions, not a bright edge-detection drawing; the original tile's individual stones and grass must match exactly pixel-for-pixel. Output one seamless square grayscale image only.
